research-memory.rationale: Own records are available; structured memory already has strong substitutes. Measure evidence recovery before adding a product.
research-memory.next_test: Compare identical source corpus and exact revision recovery with files and an existing memory tool; count maintenance overhead.

literature-evidence.rationale: Research/review tools overlap; a specific unmet evidence task and permitted corpus are missing.
literature-evidence.next_test: Find one recurring review/semantic-history question and compare expected sources against an incumbent; avoid inventing broad research agents.

model-evaluation.rationale: Evaluation/curation infrastructure exists; prediction or data-selection value needs a real labelled task, not an infrastructure clone.
model-evaluation.next_test: Use the MLflow mechanics result for infrastructure only; require a leakage-safe dataset and random/uncertainty baseline for model claims.

foundry-factories.rationale: A broad factory/cofounder platform has overlap and no demonstrated acquisition or outcome advantage.
foundry-factories.next_test: Use current Foundry for actual investigations and add only repeated missing behavior; benchmark results, not generated plans.

job-workflow.rationale: Application/marketplace primitives exist. Personal job use is available, but employer adoption and paid demand are untested.
job-workflow.next_test: Use current personal workflow and measure one concrete miss; two-sided products first need reachable employers and candidates.

skills-evidence.rationale: Portable evidence has standards; the hard unknown is whether employers will issue and trust scoped interview evidence.
skills-evidence.next_test: Test signed, revocable, consented work-sample evidence before comparative candidate ranks; obtain issuer/reviewer commitment before platform work.

regulatory-actions.rationale: Document monitoring/governance products overlap. Legal meaning, liability and buyer workflow require expertise and current source coverage.
regulatory-actions.next_test: Define one source-to-obligation decision with an expert; first test existing monitor/configuration and evidence provenance.

web-monitoring.rationale: Generic page-change detection is incumbent functionality; valuation, truth and actionable interpretation remain separate problems.
web-monitoring.next_test: Use the component trial to reject a basic detector build; test a specific permitted source and action with a real user if a narrower gap appears.

document-admin.rationale: Document storage alone is weak differentiation; reminders/errata/context are distinct jobs whose frequency and sources are not established.
document-admin.next_test: Select a permitted recurring document-to-action process; compare a directory, document tool and small script before new storage.

translation.rationale: The broad display/translation variants overlap documented existing modes; a quality gap must be demonstrated on a specific corpus.
translation.next_test: Use permitted multilingual material with bilingual checking; benchmark terminology/layout/context errors, not feature names.

sports-operations.rationale: Existing organizer tools cover broad operations; no club/coach/operator has exposed an unresolved repeated task.
sports-operations.next_test: Observe the last scheduling/payment/ranking failure in a real club before software work.

equipment-custody.rationale: Custody software and rental foundations exist; local supply, loss handling and operating economics are missing evidence.
equipment-custody.next_test: Test checkout/return exceptions with one willing operator using existing software; do not start a general rental network.

sports-video.rationale: Video analytics has strong alternatives; multi-view replay and useful amateur decisions need permitted recordings and ground truth.
sports-video.next_test: Get one coach decision and labelled video; compare manual review and a relevant incumbent before training.

physio-workflow.rationale: Practice administration and adherence tools exist; clinical workflows and outcome evidence are unavailable.
physio-workflow.next_test: Observe one clinician-approved non-diagnostic workflow; do not claim treatment improvement from app mechanics.

physical-instructions.rationale: Connected-worker and technical-assistance products overlap. Step-state verification on a narrow permitted task remains a testable but unvalidated distinction.
physical-instructions.next_test: Choose a low-risk procedure with labelled completed/incorrect/ambiguous steps and compare a static checklist plus incumbent; require skilled ground truth.

learning-tools.rationale: Existing learning primitives are strong; voice/math/driving/marketplace variants are not all solved by one comparator. No measured learning advantage yet.
learning-tools.next_test: Choose one learner error and a practical baseline; measure retention or verified task completion rather than generated content volume.

attention-habits.rationale: Interruption/blocking and simple tracking already exist; persistent messaging/offline constraints require actual device testing.
attention-habits.next_test: Use device-native controls and current apps first; isolate one repeated constraint before building another habit suite.

device-utilities.rationale: Several distinct device/voice/configuration jobs lack concrete target environments; KDE is an adjacent integration baseline, not an exact substitute for all.
device-utilities.next_test: Specify two target devices or one hardware configuration; reproduce the unmet operation with current utilities.

family-memory.rationale: Story capture/translation offerings overlap; families, rights, long-term ownership and willingness to pay remain untested.
family-memory.next_test: Compare a permitted short recording and translation/review workflow; ask who preserves and pays for the result.

creative-tools.rationale: Generation/editing tools exist; content rights, target quality and a paid repeated creator bottleneck are missing.
creative-tools.next_test: Compare a small permitted asset corpus and human editing baseline on a specific acceptance rubric.

nature-vision.rationale: Identification has established tools; species counts/tracking and difficult local conditions need their own labelled data.
nature-vision.next_test: Test one target species/scene with an expert label set and existing identifier before model development.

go-digitizer.rationale: A relevant existing project documents board-photo recognition and SGF; the workbook analogue was mismatched.
go-digitizer.next_test: Try oblique/occluded real permitted board photos before claiming a recognition gap; no own photo corpus currently available.

routes-discovery.rationale: Weather, navigation and location services exist; corridor routing, indoor mapping and hitchhiking are distinct tasks with distinct data constraints.
routes-discovery.next_test: Test a concrete public route or indoor-map dataset and specify the choice a user makes better; do not equate route generation with business value.

marketplaces.rationale: Marketplace software is available; trustworthy supply, liquidity, disputes and a reachable launch niche are unresolved.
marketplaces.next_test: Manually validate one transaction/workflow with consenting counterparties before code; no outreach or transactions performed.

browser-agent.rationale: Browser automation/evaluation components already exist; a constrained valuable action and approval model must justify integration.
browser-agent.next_test: Use a local reversible task and explicit success criteria; do not build another general browser agent.

finance.rationale: Tracking is distinct from advice, speculative returns or a marketplace. Financial validity, data rights, buyer and professional review are not established.
finance.next_test: Narrow to explainable permitted record reconciliation or scenario bookkeeping; no personalized recommendations, trades or return promises.

health-inference.rationale: Health or consequential inference needs credible ground truth and specialist/physical validation; adjacent sources do not establish efficacy.
health-inference.next_test: Prefer non-diagnostic recordkeeping if useful; require qualified review and approved data before physiological, safety or individual-trait claims.

social-dating.rationale: Trust, consent, moderation and enough participating users matter more than a generic matching algorithm.
social-dating.next_test: Test a consented narrow social workflow before scoring people or building a network.

adult-wellness.rationale: No confirmed adult consenting-user workflow, rights-cleared corpus or distribution advantage; no explicit content generated.
adult-wellness.next_test: Define a lawful consent-first non-explicit service or educational need with an adult buyer; no biometric sexual-performance scoring.

games.rationale: Entertainment concepts need player enjoyment and repeat play; a generic model demo or a workbook analogue does not establish this.
games.next_test: A paper/stock-engine prototype and independent playtest should precede a large technical build; Anki is only adjacent to quiz mechanics.

content-business.rationale: These are formats/content propositions, not demonstrated missing software. Rights, production cost and audience retention dominate.
content-business.next_test: Produce one permitted sample only after choosing an audience/distribution test; no fabricated revenue model.

physical-products.rationale: Physical ergonomics, manufacture, durability and field performance cannot be established by this software-only campaign. Comparator sources apply only to the matching mosquito/earring concepts.
physical-products.next_test: Specify one measurable benefit over an actual off-the-shelf alternative and obtain permitted physical test/owner access before tooling or inventory.

physical-venues.rationale: Premises, permits, staffing, demand and unit economics are key; marketplace software is at most an enabling tool.
physical-venues.next_test: Observe a local operating/service test before equipment, premises or app investment.

deep-infrastructure.rationale: Energy generation and GPU networks require physical/operating economics and buyers; a software framework is not evidence of feasibility.
deep-infrastructure.next_test: Compare measured cost/reliability against existing suppliers before a prototype; cited software is adjacent only.

unacceptable-premise.rationale: Current wording involves deception, harmful deployment, unsupported person inference, or unresolved consent/trust; no such capability will be prototyped. Individual reasons below distinguish these cases.
unacceptable-premise.next_test: Reframe toward consented skill evidence, learning, prevention or safe simulation; do not infer honesty from faces/voices or optimize real-world harm.

code-translation.rationale: Code translation needs an execution-equivalence task, not a language-translation analogy.
code-translation.next_test: Choose a language pair and permitted test corpus; identify the strongest compiler/transpiler baseline.

coupon-wallet.rationale: Coupon aggregation needs merchant coverage, accurate eligibility and a distribution channel.
coupon-wallet.next_test: Compare actual offers and redemption workflow with an existing wallet; no merchant or user corpus available.
